name: Bakunyuu Tengoku Angel Bitches
original_name: 爆乳天国エンジェルビッチーズ
source:
Sex between humans and angels provides humans with pleasure that defies all common sense. The price for this, however, is such extreme exhaustion that they can’t stand up for two or three days.

The Angel Bitches, who punish humans for their sins, have once again set out for the human city today, leading their troops.

One of those soldiers is the protagonist of this story—“me”!

Together with the Angel Bitches, I’ll ravage the people of the city and mete out their punishment!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ337973.html/?locale=ja_JP]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
人类与天使交合，能带给人类超越一切常识的极致快感；然而享乐的代价也极为沉重——事后往往会陷入连续两三天都站不起来的极度虚脱状态。

专门惩戒人类罪孽的“碧池天使团”，今天也率领部队浩浩荡荡地开赴人类都市。

而隶属于这支部队的一名士兵，正是本故事的主人公——“我”！

我将与碧池天使们并肩出击，尽情蹂躏城中的民众，向他们降下惩罚！！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ337973.html/?locale=ja_JP]DLsite[/url]]
